description.value: White Lotus Cafe is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant in North Burnaby serving pho, Bún Bò Huế, bánh mì made with daily-baked bread, and fresh salad rolls. The cafe offers dine-in with reservations, online takeout ordering, full catering services, and private event packages. Customer reviews consistently single out the Spicy Beef & Pork Noodle Soup as among the best in the greater Vancouver area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, actively operating Vietnamese restaurant at 1-5901 Broadway, Burnaby, BC — not North Vancouver as indicated in the OSM community field. Phone number matches between OSM and website. The website explicitly confirms online takeout ordering and a labelled Vegetarian (VG) Banh Mi on the menu, but provides no evidence of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website address is 1-5901 Broadway, Burnaby, BC V5B 2Y1 — the business is in Burnaby (North Burnaby), not North Vancouver.
OSM record contains no street address; full address was sourced from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Vietnamese restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and recent positive reviews. No grounds for exclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels a Vegetarian (VG) Banh Mi with fried tofu and vegetarian 'ham' (excludes pate)
